description: Validation errors from Save project and Map thread are rendered only at the top of the Control pane, out of the viewport when the person is at the form, and are cleared by the next poll (same root cause as F-111-01). The URL-form repository, missing tasks and missing senders were all effectively invisible.
expected: An inline error under the offending field (GitHub repository, Authorized tasks, Authorized senders), kept until the person edits it.
actual: The banner is about 400 px above the button and disappears within 1–2.5 s. The screenshot at the time of failure shows no error.
suggested_fix: Render per-form errors next to the submit button or field, and validate the required pickers client-side before posting.

description: With Control settings collapsed, its summary sits flush on the Cursor Cloud h2 (about 9 px between baselines and no visible gap), and the mapped T3 thread section is rendered below the Cursor Cloud section and its Register Cloud context disclosure, so the T3 card looks like part of Cursor Cloud.
expected: T3 sessions directly under the T3 status/settings, then a clearly separated Cursor Cloud section.
actual: Order: Control status, Control settings, Cursor Cloud (status, note, Register), then the T3 thread card.
suggested_fix: Render the T3 session list before the Cloud section, wrap each provider in its own section with a heading, and give the details/summary a bottom margin.

description: A normal running run shows a boxed alert-style notice "Dispatch held: Awaiting this controller's active run" on the session. Other copy is jargon too: "Authorize explicit task IDs; wildcard dispatch is not supported", "Each T3 thread needs one route and each route its own Actor", and "run not established".
expected: Normal queueing reads as status ("Next follow-up waits for the current run"). Errors say what to tick ("Choose at least one task this thread may work on").
actual: The 'held' and 'wildcard dispatch' wording makes routine states look like faults.
suggested_fix: Show the 'awaiting active run' hold as neutral status rather than a held notice, and rewrite the validation messages in task terms.

description: Accept and Reject are identical full-width grey buttons stacked 10 px apart. After acceptance the verdict evidence is not shown anywhere and the verdict form stays fully active.
expected: Distinct Accept (primary) and Reject (secondary/danger) side by side, with the recorded evidence shown with the verdict ("accepted by Maya Okafor · Ran npm test, 214 passed…").
actual: The two buttons have equal weight, and the attested evidence is invisible after saving.
suggested_fix: Put the buttons side by side with distinct styles, show the evidence under each verdict, and collapse the form once a verdict of that kind exists.

description: A thread mapping cannot be removed, and its authorized tasks or senders cannot be edited, from the UI (flag #53). /sessions/delete is refused with 403 'Unsupported control endpoint'. The Agent select keeps offering an agent that is already mapped, and choosing it fails with AMBIGUOUS_ROUTE.
expected: Edit and Unmap actions on the session card. Agents that are already mapped are disabled in the select.
actual: Mappings are permanent in the UI.
suggested_fix: Add an edit form for allowedTaskIds/allowedFromActorIds and an Unmap action (allowed when no work is unresolved), and filter mapped agents out of the select.

description: The Map form's Project select does not preselect the only control project, and the control project has to be typed again (ID, name, repository) even though the Pardner project is Ledgerline. Project ID 'Ledger Line' is rejected as 'must be a nonempty identifier'.
expected: Defaults carry the user: one project is preselected, and the name is prefilled from the Pardner project. The identifier error names the allowed characters.
actual: The same values are typed and chosen again, and the identifier error is misleading.
suggested_fix: Default the select when there is one option, prefill from the Pardner project, and say 'Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes'.

description: Run cards show raw T3 run IDs ('run run:thread:thr_01JD8M4Q:ordinal:1') and showed 'Not read from T3 yet' next to an established Running run.
expected: A short run label ('Run 1') with the full ID in a tooltip or copy button, and a freshness label that agrees with the session's 'Read Ns ago'.
actual: Internal identifiers are shown inline, and the freshness wording is contradictory.
suggested_fix: Format run IDs, and derive card freshness from the session read when the run itself has not been read yet.
